import sys

def main():
    import sys
    w1 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    h1 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    w2 = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    h2 = int(sys.stdin.readline())

    # Calculate the total area covered by the ship
    total_area = w1 * h1 + w2 * h2

    # Calculate the perimeter of the ship
    # The ship has two rectangles, one on top of the other
    # The perimeter includes the outer edges of both rectangles
    # and the inner edge where they touch (which is counted twice)
    perimeter = 2 * (w1 + h1 + w2 + h2 - min(w1, w2))

    # The number of cells to mark is the perimeter minus the area of the ship
    # plus the area of the ship itself (since we need to count the cells around the ship)
    # This is equivalent to just the perimeter
    result = perimeter

    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
